title: Native test execution cannot supervise a child process
observed_need: Run the current MNCS compiler/runtime, enforce a wall-clock timeout, capture stdout/stderr, and preserve the child exit status.
current_language_behavior: MNCS has no process-spawn, subprocess-capture, environment, signal, or wall-clock timeout primitive at the external-consumer boundary. mncs-embed now supplies a retained in-process session for executable artifacts, but the CLI/compiler launch and fallback supervision boundary remains external.
why_insufficient: A native test framework still needs a host adapter to launch the compiler, enforce the outer timeout, and retain a fallback when the shared embed library is unavailable.
minimal_reproducer: tools/mncs_test.py: run_process([mncs, 'test-inventory', source], timeout=timeout_seconds) plus the one-time compile/embed-library boundary
desired_direction: A bounded, capability-controlled runtime/tooling process-session API with explicit stdout/stderr, exit status, timeout, cancellation, and provenance semantics.
workaround: Python stdlib subprocess.run is used only for compiler inventory/compile launch, capture, timeout, and the explicit no-embed fallback; mncs-embed performs normal per-test execution and Python does not evaluate tests.
